story.title: Healthy Hilda and Her Friends !
paragraphs_en: One lovely sunny morning Hilda sat beneath her favourite oak tree enjoying a delicious sweet apple. Her friend Fifi the Bunny came and sat beside her. Fifi looked very hungry. Hilda offered her apple to Fifi. Fifi looked at the apple for a brief moment and was disgusted , she refused to eat something healthy. "Why are you eating that ? Come let's go to the shop and buy some chips , those are yummy , " Fifi called out to Hilda. Just then , Randy the bear came out of the bushes.

Randy was their good friend. " Hilda ! Randy ! Come on ! Let's go get lots of chips and cold drinks for us to eat, the shop won't close until 7:00. We have time , " Fifi insisted. Just then some more friends were walking by. "Hey guys !" , called Tammy the tortoise and Louise the Lion. Louise and Tammy came into the park. " Come on ! Why don't we go to the shop and get some chips! Why don't we ! why don't we !" Said Fifi getting very frustrated. Louise looked at Hilda. "Aren't you going to tell her ? " , she said.

"Listen , Fifi" , Hilda , Randy , Louise and Tammy said , " These 'chips' and 'cold drinks' that you are always eating, they are not healthy." , they explained. "What do you mean 'not healthy' ?!" Fifi asked , puzzled and irritated. The sun started to set. " They are yummy , sure. But they have no nutritional value. All these chips , cakes etc. , they are not good for your body and makes it sad , upset and unwell . You wouldn't want your body to be sad , upset and unwell , right ?"

"Oh , now I understand. But, does that mean I won't eat chips , cold drinks and all these ever again?" Fifi asked. "Of course you'll get to eat them ,but you should eat less of them and exercise ,that means doing anything at your own pace as long as you get moving." The friends told Fifi. "Now I understood , I'm going to do these things and get healthy !" Fifi said ,motivated. "That'll be great! " everyone smiled and had fun playing in the park until it was time to sleep. They looked at the night sky and wished each other a good night.
